newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower and still rangebound.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower and still rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures limped lower in thin dealings, while prices remained stuck in their recent trading range.
A dearth of news and the nearly four months remaining before the March contract expires is likely to keep pressure off the market, dealers said.
Open interest in March rose a mere 85 lots to 84,887 lots.
Volume was estimated at only 7,447 lots.
March closed 0.06 lower at 10.82, having ranged from 10.87 to 10.77. The back months settled 0.01 lower to 0.03 firmer.
Support remained in the mid 10.70-cent per lb range and resistance in the mid 10.90s, dealers said.
